artifacts.synopsis: TE David Kniseley and others challenged Rocky Mountain Presbytery's approval of the public title “Minister of Church Life” for an unordained female staff member. The SJC denied the complaint, holding that “minister” has a specific technical meaning in the BCO but that the BCO is silent on generic titles for non-ordained staff, leaving that use to lower-court judgment subject to BCO 40-2(3); a dissent disagreed.

artifacts.title: Dissolution of pastoral charge outside presbytery's jurisdiction

matches.evidence: BCO 23-1 does not apply to non-PCA churches outside presbytery jurisdiction; a congregational vote cannot substitute for that chapter's dissolution process.

artifacts.title: Teaching elder voting rights and congregational approval of pastoral salary changes

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that a teaching elder votes as a full session member, and that any change to pastoral salary terms requires congregational approval as part of the call.
